<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity="0.7"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g fill="#110053" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif">
    <text x="19" y="22" font-size="13px" font-weight="700">9:41</text>
    <rect x="330" y="12" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="336" y="10" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="342" y="8" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="16" x2="355" y2="11" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="355" y1="11" x2="359" y2="16" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="366" y="9" width="17" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="11" width="11" height="6" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="383" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="29" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="28,58 21,65 28,72" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="65" x2="39" y2="65" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <text x="54" y="67" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Baggage</text>
    <circle cx="359" cy="58" r="13" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="359" cy="54" r="3.2" fill="#110053"/>
    <ellipse cx="359" cy="63" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip summary -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="113" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Your trip</text>
    <text x="20" y="137" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="22px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Cali</text>
    <text x="185" y="137" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="22px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Bogotá</text>
    <line x1="83" y1="130" x2="166" y2="130" stroke="#0BAEAF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="166,130 157,125 157,135" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <circle cx="83" cy="130" r="4" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <text x="20" y="158" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Mar 18 Jun · 1 passenger · Economy</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Tabs -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="178" width="358" height="48" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="195" y="179" width="178" height="46" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <text x="104" y="208" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Outbound</text>
    <text x="284" y="208" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Return</text>
    <line x1="211" y1="222" x2="357" y2="222" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Informative banner -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="242" width="362" height="112" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="270" r="9" fill="#4658E0"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="266" x2="39" y2="275" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="263" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="57" y="268" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Outbound flight completed</text>
    <text x="28" y="294" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#110053">Additional baggage can no longer be</text>
    <text x="28" y="315" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#110053">added to the Cali → Bogotá flight.</text>
    <text x="28" y="339" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">You can review your return allowance below.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Return flight card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="14" y="369" width="362" height="90" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="29" y="391" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">RETURN FLIGHT · LA 4052</text>
    <text x="29" y="419" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Bogotá</text>
    <text x="161" y="419" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">→</text>
    <text x="190" y="419" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Cali</text>
    <text x="29" y="443" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Fri 21 Jun · 18:40 – 19:45</text>
    <rect x="293" y="401" width="63" height="24" rx="12" fill="#E8F8F7"/>
    <text x="324" y="417" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#0BAEAF">CONFIRMED</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Baggage section -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="493" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Baggage allowance</text>
    <text x="16" y="517" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Passenger: Valentina Rojas</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Allowance card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="14" y="534" width="362" height="104" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="580" r="22" fill="#1B0188"/>
    <rect x="35" y="575" width="22" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="575" x2="40" y2="570" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="575" x2="52" y2="570" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="570" x2="52" y2="570" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="80" y="566" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Carry-on baggage</text>
    <text x="80" y="589" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">1 piece included · up to 10 kg</text>
    <line x1="80" y1="603" x2="350" y2="603" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="80" y="624" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#0BAEAF">Included with your fare</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Add baggage card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="653" width="362" height="76" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="691" r="17" fill="#F3F2F7"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="691" x2="50" y2="691" stroke="#858585" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="684" x2="43" y2="698" stroke="#858585" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="70" y="683" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Add checked baggage</text>
    <text x="70" y="706" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#858585">Unavailable after flight departure</text>
    <text x="346" y="693" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#858585">Unavailable</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g transform="translate(39,784)">
      <polygon points="0,10 10,2 20,10" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <rect x="4" y="10" width="12" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="10" y="37" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(124,784)">
      <rect x="2" y="5" width="18" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="6" y1="2" x2="6" y2="8" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="8" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="11" y="37" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Trips</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(211,784)">
      <circle cx="11" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="11" y1="5" x2="11" y2="15" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="6" y1="10" x2="16" y2="10" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="11" y="37" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#9747FF">Bags</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(302,784)">
      <circle cx="11" cy="7" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="11" cy="17" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="11" y="37" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Account</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
